_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：need/dare 作情態助動詞 vs 一般動詞（eng.t_sub.modal.need-dare）。情態用法：主要在否定/疑問，接原形、無 -s、不用 do（You needn't go；Need I go?；He dare not say；daren't）。一般動詞用法：用 do/does + to（You don't need to go；He doesn't dare to say）。形式依 Swan/Cambridge，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: need / dare 作情態助動詞
units.can_do: 我能分辨 need/dare 的兩種用法：當情態助動詞時主要出現在否定/疑問、接原形、沒有 -s、不用 do（You needn't go／He dare not speak）；當一般動詞時用 do/does 和 to（You don't need to go／He doesn't dare to speak）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: As a modal, 'need' appears mainly in negatives and questions, takes a bare infinitive (no 'to'), has no '-s', and forms negatives and questions without 'do': 'You needn't worry.' 'Need I say more?'
claims.verification_ref: 情態 need 多用於否定/疑問，接原形無 to、無 -s、不用 do（You needn't worry; Need I say more?）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: As an ordinary verb, 'need' uses 'do/does' and 'to + verb': 'You don't need to worry.' 'Does he need to come?'
claims.verification_ref: 一般動詞 need 用 do/does + to（You don't need to worry; Does he need to come?）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: As a modal, 'dare' takes a bare infinitive and forms negatives and questions without 'do', with no '-s': 'He dare not tell her.' / 'daren't' 'Dare you ask?'
claims.verification_ref: 情態 dare 接原形、不用 do、無 -s（He dare not tell her / daren't; Dare you ask?）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: As an ordinary verb, 'dare' uses 'do' and usually 'to': 'He doesn't dare to tell her.' 'She didn't dare to move.'
claims.verification_ref: 一般動詞 dare 用 do + (to)（He doesn't dare to tell her）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'need' can be a modal verb. As a modal it appears mostly in negatives and questions, takes a bare verb (no 'to'), has no '-s', and does not use 'do': 'You needn't worry.' 'Need I say more?'
teach.zh_hint: need 可以當情態助動詞。當情態時多半出現在否定、疑問句，後面接原形（不加 to）、沒有 -s、也不用 do：You needn't worry.（你不必擔心。）Need I say more?（我還需要多說嗎？）

teach.body: 'need' is more often an ordinary verb, using 'do/does' and 'to': 'You don't need to worry.' 'Does he need to come?' This form is safe to use in all situations.
teach.zh_hint: need 更常當一般動詞，用 do/does 和 to：You don't need to worry.（你不必擔心。）Does he need to come?（他需要來嗎？）這個用法在各種情況都安全好用。

teach.body: You needn't bring any money. You don't need to bring any money.
teach.zh_hint: 兩句意思一樣：你不必帶錢。上句是情態（needn't + 原形），下句是一般動詞（don't need to + 原形）。

teach.body: 'dare' works the same way. As a modal: bare verb, no 'do', no '-s': 'He dare not tell her.' ('daren't') 'Dare you ask the teacher?' As an ordinary verb it uses 'do' and usually 'to': 'He doesn't dare to tell her.'
teach.zh_hint: dare 的道理一樣。當情態：接原形、不用 do、無 -s：He dare not tell her.（他不敢告訴她。）／Dare you ask the teacher?（你敢問老師嗎？）當一般動詞則用 do 和（通常）to：He doesn't dare to tell her.

teach.body: She dare not open the door. He doesn't dare to speak in class.
teach.zh_hint: 她不敢開門（情態 dare not + 原形）。他不敢在課堂上發言（一般動詞 doesn't dare to + 原形）。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（情態 need，＝不必）：Everything is fine. You ____ worry.

distractor_rationales.needn't to: 情態 need 後面接原形，不加 to，所以不是 needn't to worry。
distractor_rationales.need not to: need not 後面也不加 to；應該是 need not worry（＝needn't worry）。
distractor_rationales.don't needn't: 不能把一般動詞的 don't 和情態的 needn't 疊在一起，文法錯誤。

practice.feedback: 情態 need 接原形、不加 to：You needn't worry（你不必擔心）。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（情態 need 的疑問句）：Need I ____ now?（我現在需要走嗎？go）

distractor_rationales.to go: 情態 need 後面接原形，不加 to。
distractor_rationales.going: 情態助動詞後面接原形，不接 -ing。
distractor_rationales.goes: 情態助動詞後面一律原形，不會有 -s。

practice.feedback: 情態 need 接原形：Need I go now?

practice.stem: 選正確形式（一般動詞 need 的否定）：He ____ to leave early today.

distractor_rationales.needn't: needn't 是情態用法、後面接原形（needn't leave），不會接 to leave。
distractor_rationales.don't need: 主詞是 He（第三人稱），一般動詞要用 doesn't，不是 don't。
distractor_rationales.needs not: 一般動詞的否定用 doesn't need，不是 needs not。

practice.feedback: 一般動詞 need 用 do/does + to：He doesn't need to leave early。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（情態 dare，＝不敢）：He is too scared; he ____ not tell anyone the secret.

distractor_rationales.dares: 情態 dare 沒有 -s，所以不是 dares not。
distractor_rationales.daring: 情態助動詞後面不用 -ing 形。
distractor_rationales.to dare: 這裡 dare 本身就是助動詞（dare not tell），不會寫成 to dare。

practice.feedback: 情態 dare 無 -s、接原形：He dare not tell anyone（他不敢告訴任何人）。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（情態 dare 的疑問句）：____ she ask the teacher a difficult question?（她敢問老師難題嗎？）

distractor_rationales.Dares: 情態 dare 沒有 -s，疑問句直接把 Dare 放句首。
distractor_rationales.Does dare: 情態 dare 自己當助動詞，不再加 does；Does 要配原形一般動詞 dare to。
distractor_rationales.Daring: 疑問句不用 -ing 形開頭。

practice.feedback: 情態 dare 疑問句直接倒裝、無 -s：Dare she ask the teacher?

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀句子，注意情態用法 needn't、dare not 後面都直接接原形；一邊讀一邊想「這是情態用法還是一般動詞用法」。

lines.text: You needn't bring any money; everything is free today.
He dare not open the door, because he is afraid of the dark.
